description: New agent that reads bookmarks classified as scenario-candidate / capability-class-flag / marketing-positioning. For each, optionally investigates (checks for existing similar scenarios, identifies dependencies, infers audience from operator notes + linked content). Surfaces idea candidates to vision-walk-prep in a structured format. The agent does NOT make decisions; it pre-processes for the operators morning walk. Should run on a schedule (frequency TBD during execution) or be triggerable on demand. Initiative: bookmark-intelligence-hub-rework-and-ideation. See orchestration-summary.md for context. Depends on: bih-v0-redesign-manual-paste-first. Acceptance: running the agent against a corpus of bookmarks produces a structured candidate list; output format is consumable by vision-walk-prep (see related backlog item bih-vision-walk-prep-integration).
name: bih-ideation-extraction-agent
title: BIH ideation-extraction agent
